sentences.en: You're very well-versed in hockey.
sentences.zh: 你对冰球确实非常精通。

sentences.en: I don't get hockey.
sentences.zh: 我不懂冰球。

sentences.en: I'm, like, into those sports.
sentences.zh: 我挺喜欢那些运动的。

sentences.en: It's a live hockey game.
sentences.zh: 这是一场现场冰球比赛。

sentences.en: There's nothing like it.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比这更棒的了。

sentences.en: I think it's the best sport to watch live.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是现场观看体验最好的运动。

sentences.en: Personally, I know people love watching basketball live.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，我知道人们很喜欢现场看篮球。

sentences.en: I mean, watching basketball live, especially if you can get close to the court, it's, like,
sentences.zh: 我是说，现场看篮球，尤其是如果你能坐得离球场很近的话，那真是，怎么说呢，

sentences.en: an amazing game live.
sentences.zh: 现场看比赛太棒了。

sentences.en: I just love the whole hockey community.
sentences.zh: 我就是喜欢整个冰球圈子。

sentences.en: I love everything about it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢关于它的一切。

sentences.en: I went one time and met some of your hockey mom friends.
sentences.zh: 我有一次去现场，还见到了你的一些冰球妈妈朋友。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what I didn't know, you guys, is that hockey games, they serve beer at 10 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 而且我不知道的是，伙计们，冰球比赛竟然在早上10点就供应啤酒。

sentences.en: They do.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，天哪。

sentences.en: They sure do.
sentences.zh: 他们确实供应。

sentences.en: We have, like, juice boxes at soccer.
sentences.zh: 我们看足球赛时喝的是果汁盒。

sentences.en: They have beer.
sentences.zh: 他们却喝啤酒。

sentences.en: I remember going to, like, one of our early hockey games for my son, and it was at 730
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次去参加我儿子早期的冰球比赛，时间是早上7点半，

sentences.en: in the morning, and I brought a coffee.
sentences.zh: 我带了一杯咖啡。

sentences.en: And people were like, does anyone want a beer from the concessions?
sentences.zh: 结果有人问，有人想从小卖部买啤酒吗？

sentences.en: And I was like, um, I don't think so, but thank you.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，呃，我想不用了，但谢谢你。

sentences.en: Pretty amazing.
sentences.zh: 真是太神奇了。

sentences.en: Well, listen, the Dream Team has lost a member, and they get back to Michael's condo.
sentences.zh: 好了，听着，“梦之队”失去了一名成员，他们回到了迈克尔的公寓。

sentences.en: Ryan's going to run inside.
sentences.zh: 瑞安要跑进去。

sentences.en: He wants to watch the closer on TNT.
sentences.zh: 他想看TNT电视台播出的《结案高手》。

sentences.en: Very important to him.
sentences.zh: 这对我很重要。

sentences.en: Pam's upset she can't get out of the car.
sentences.zh: 帕姆很沮丧，因为她没法下车。

sentences.en: Now Pam's going to spiral.
sentences.zh: 现在帕姆要崩溃了。

sentences.en: So guess what?
sentences.zh: 所以你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: It was not in the script that you stayed in the car.
sentences.zh: 剧本里并没有写你要待在车里。

sentences.en: I remember.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: It was Jen Salata's idea, and she fought for it to have Pam stay in the car during the scene.
sentences.zh: 那是简·萨拉塔的主意，她极力争取让帕姆在这一幕中留在车里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I was supposed to get out of the car, and then sort of the idea was lean against it.
sentences.zh: 我本来应该下车的，然后大概的想法是靠在车边。

sentences.en: And part of that was because it would be really easy to stage it camera-wise.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是这样在摄影机调度上会非常容易。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, I loved her staying in the car, and I love this shot at 16 minutes, 22 seconds,
sentences.zh: 我喜欢她留在车里的安排，我也很喜欢16分22秒时的那个镜头，

sentences.en: when you see Pam in the side mirror and Michael standing next to the car.
sentences.zh: 你可以从侧视镜里看到帕姆，而迈克尔就站在车旁。

sentences.en: It's such a cool shot.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常酷的镜头。

sentences.en: I had to bring a lot of emotion to this scene.
sentences.zh: 我必须为这一幕投入大量的情感。

sentences.en: You had to see Pam be convinced by Michael, and this is one of those moments when
sentences.zh: 你必须看到帕姆被迈克尔说服，而这正是其中一个时刻，

sentences.en: Michael becomes really good at being a boss.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔展现出了他作为老板非常出色的一面。

sentences.en: And he's so serious.
sentences.zh: 而且他表现得非常严肃。

sentences.en: He's like, listen, kiddo.
sentences.zh: 他说，听着，小姑娘。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You quit.
sentences.zh: 你辞职了。

sentences.en: I quit.
sentences.zh: 我辞职了。

sentences.en: So that's the truth.
sentences.zh: 事实就是这样。

sentences.en: It was very easy to get emotional because to have Steve Carell say, listen, kiddo, I mean,
sentences.zh: 要投入情感非常容易，因为当史蒂夫·卡瑞尔说“听着，小姑娘”时，我是说，

sentences.en: I know he wasn't much older than us, but he did always have sort of like a wise fatherly.
sentences.zh: 我知道他其实没比我们大多少，但他确实总是带有一种睿智的父爱感。

sentences.en: He was our mentor.
sentences.zh: 他是我们的导师。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Like, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是这样。

sentences.en: And so to have your mentor coach you, it felt real, you know?
sentences.zh: 所以能让自己的导师来指导自己，感觉真的很真实，你懂吗？

sentences.en: And it made me emotional, and we just really connected there in a real way.
sentences.zh: 这让我很感动，我们当时真的建立了一种真实的联结。

sentences.en: And it was really sweet.
sentences.zh: 真的很温馨。

sentences.en: I just love those Pam Michael moments that reminds me of when he came to her art show.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢那些帕姆和迈克尔的瞬间，让我想起他去参加她画展的时候。

sentences.en: And he shows up for her.
sentences.zh: 他总是会支持她。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And it was great.
sentences.zh: 那真的很棒。

sentences.en: Well, next, we're going to see Michael on the phone, and he's asking Billy Merchant if
sentences.zh: 好了，接下来我们要看到迈克尔在打电话，他问比利·默钱特

sentences.en: he has any free office space anywhere because they can't work out of Michael's condo anymore.
sentences.zh: 有没有空余的办公空间，因为他们不能再在迈克尔的公寓里办公了。

sentences.en: They're going to throw him out.
sentences.zh: 他们要把他赶出去了。

sentences.en: They got a letter.
sentences.zh: 他们收到了一封信。

sentences.en: And Billy says, I got something for you.
sentences.zh: 然后比利说，我这儿有地方给你。

sentences.en: It's like a supply room, maybe.
sentences.zh: 大概像是个储藏室之类的。

sentences.en: But there's also like a shower.
sentences.zh: 但里面还有个淋浴间。

sentences.en: It's also back at the Dunder Mifflin Scranton building.
sentences.zh: 而且还是在邓德·米夫林斯克兰顿分公司的楼里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I probably should have led with that.
sentences.zh: 我本来应该先说这个的。

sentences.en: And that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 你说得太对了。

sentences.en: It's like a supply room closet.
sentences.zh: 那就像个储藏室壁橱。

sentences.en: But the gang is like, I could work here.
sentences.zh: 但大家却觉得，我可以在这儿工作。

sentences.en: Yeah, they can see it.
sentences.zh: 没错，他们能看出潜力。

sentences.en: And it's really sweet because the episode ends with Michael adding Michael Scott Paper
sentences.zh: 这真的很温馨，因为剧集结尾是迈克尔把“迈克尔·斯科特造纸公司”

sentences.en: Company to the little board in the lobby, and Pam's handing him the little letters.
sentences.zh: 加到了大厅的小告示板上，帕姆递给他那些小字母。

sentences.en: Matt Sohn shared that there was a take where instead of you guys already having the letters,
sentences.zh: 马特·索恩分享说，有一个拍摄版本里，你们不是已经有了字母，

sentences.en: that you were taking the letters from other people's businesses' names.
sentences.zh: 而是从其他公司的名字里把字母抠下来。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我记得那个。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我也记得。

sentences.en: Which is really funny to me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那真的很有趣。

sentences.en: And there was a tag that didn't make it in the episode.
sentences.zh: 还有一个没被剪进正片的彩蛋。

sentences.en: Kevin is back at reception.
sentences.zh: 凯文回到了前台。

sentences.en: The phone rings.
sentences.zh: 电话响了。

sentences.en: Kevin answers it.
sentences.zh: 凯文接起电话。

sentences.en: And he's able to transfer the call to Dwight successfully.
sentences.zh: 他成功地把电话转接给了德怀特。

sentences.en: He's so happy.
sentences.zh: 他特别开心。

sentences.en: He looks all cocky to camera.
sentences.zh: 他对着镜头一脸得意。

sentences.en: Charles comes out and says, hey, Kevin, I need you to set up a conference call with David
sentences.zh: 查尔斯走出来说，嘿，凯文，我需要你十分钟后安排一场和大卫·华莱士

sentences.en: Wallace and the other branch managers in 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 以及其他分公司经理的电话会议。

sentences.en: I'll take it in the conference room.
sentences.zh: 我会去会议室接听。

sentences.en: Kevin looks like he's going to crap his pants.
sentences.zh: 凯文看起来快要吓尿了。

sentences.en: He goes, you got it, boss.
sentences.zh: 他说，没问题，老板。

sentences.en: And then he runs out of the office and never comes back.
sentences.zh: 然后他就跑出了办公室，再也没回来。

sentences.en: You know, I asked Brian, what was it like to be at the reception desk for that week?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，我问过布莱恩，在那一周坐在前台是什么感觉？

sentences.en: You know, because I noticed throughout the whole episode, he's in the background.
sentences.zh: 因为我注意到在整集里，他都在背景里。

sentences.en: And he was doing what I had to do, which is be in the background a lot.
sentences.zh: 他做着我以前必须做的事，那就是经常待在背景里。

sentences.en: And he did point out that just because you guys were in the corner, which is something
sentences.zh: 他确实指出，就因为你们当时被挤在角落里，这也是你们

sentences.en: you've talked about, you know, they would make you guys stand at the copier.
sentences.zh: 提到过的事，他们会让你们站在复印机旁边。

sentences.en: So he was just happy he got to sit for his background work.
sentences.zh: 所以他只是因为能坐着做背景工作就很高兴了。

sentences.en: I'm telling you, I stood for almost nine years.
sentences.zh: 我跟你说，我站了快九年了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个。

sentences.en: Well, that was Dream Team.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那是梦之队。

sentences.en: Next up is Michael Scott Paper Company.
sentences.zh: 接下来是迈克尔·斯科特造纸公司。

sentences.en: We're going to get busy in that little storage room.
sentences.zh: 我们要在那间小储藏室里忙活起来了。

sentences.en: I can't wait.
sentences.zh: 我等不及了。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Have a great week, you guys.
sentences.zh: 祝大家这周过得愉快。

sentences.en: See you then.
sentences.zh: 到时候见。
